about: StormSim SF emergency-response cost table (owned by sim/response.py). The model chooses quantities/actions only; every price here is fixed and cited. FEMA equipment rates exclude operator labor (added via labor items). Retrieved 25.10.2026.

shelter_person_night.what: Congregate shelter operations (staff, cots, sanitation, utilities) per occupant-night
shelter_person_night.source: Cost comparison of congregate, motel and village-type shelters, J. Social Distress & Homelessness (2025), doi:10.1080/10530789.2025.2473756: congregate shelter operating cost $16,654 per bed-year -> /365 = $45.63/bed-night. Cross-check: FEMA PA appeal (Hurricane Dorian, Coastal Carolina Univ.) accepted $15/person-night for facility use alone, https://www.fema.gov/appeal/evacuation-medical-care-and-sheltering-ineligible-costs

meal.what: Shelf-stable meal / MRE delivered to a shelter
meal.source: DHS OIG-20-76 (Sep 2020), FEMA commodity distribution Hurricanes Irma & Maria, Table of estimated commodity costs: meals $5.16/unit, https://www.oig.dhs.gov/sites/default/files/assets/2020-09/OIG-20-76-Sep20.pdf

water_gal.source: DHS OIG-20-76 (Sep 2020): water $0.55/unit (1 L bottle assumed) -> x3.785 = $2.08/gal, https://www.oig.dhs.gov/sites/default/files/assets/2020-09/OIG-20-76-Sep20.pdf

cot.what: Shelter cot (one per shelter space opened)

truck_hour.source: FEMA 2023 Schedule of Equipment Rates, cost code 8701-1 Truck, Flatbed 4X2 25KGVW DSL, $35.58/h, https://www.fema.gov/sites/default/files/documents/fema_schedule-of-equipment-rates_2023.pdf

driver_hour.source: BLS OEWS May 2023, Heavy & tractor-trailer truck drivers (53-3032), San Francisco-Oakland-Hayward MSA mean $32.48/h, https://www.bls.gov/oes/2023/may/oes533032.htm ; x1.5 fringe/overhead burden (planning factor, FEMA PA reimburses actual fringe)

crew_person_hour.what: Response crew member (sandbag, pump, tree, medical, shelter staff), burdened
crew_person_hour.source: BLS OEWS May 2024, San Francisco-Oakland-Fremont MSA all-occupations mean $48.15/h, https://www.bls.gov/regions/west/news-release/2025/occupationalemploymentandwages_sanfrancisco_20250501.htm ; x1.5 fringe/overhead burden (planning factor)

bus_hour.what: Evacuation bus / paratransit for no-car vulnerable residents (equipment)
bus_hour.source: FEMA 2023 Schedule of Equipment Rates, cost code 8180 Bus, $41.46/h (operator via driver_hour)

rescue_boat_hour.source: FEMA 2023 Schedule of Equipment Rates, cost code 8138 Boat, Jet (shallow draft, 20 ft), $30.93/h

pump_hour.source: FEMA 2023 Schedule of Equipment Rates, cost code 8465 Pump, Trash Pump 6 in DIESEL, $60.83/h

generator_hour.what: 150 kW portable diesel generator for a shelter
generator_hour.source: FEMA 2023 Schedule of Equipment Rates, cost code 8314 Generator DIESEL 150 KW, $85.00/h

ambulance_hour.what: Ambulance standby at a medical post (equipment)
ambulance_hour.source: FEMA 2023 Schedule of Equipment Rates, cost code 8041 Ambulance GVW 11000 lb, $48.32/h

sandbag.source: Sandbag Cost Analysis (2023, cited in data/reference/unit_costs_research.json 'sandbag_*'): 'widely accepted that sandbags cost $.25 each'; USACE pyramid dike bag counts

alert_message.what: AlertSF / WEA alert (existing city system, no marginal cost)
alert_message.source: SF Department of Emergency Management, AlertSF (https://www.sf.gov/alertsf) and FEMA IPAWS Wireless Emergency Alerts: no per-message charge to the city

shelter_m2_per_person.source: FEMA P-785 Shelter Field Guide (with American Red Cross): 'allow 40 square feet of space per person'; FEMA Mega-Shelter Planning Guide: minimum 40 sq ft per person; https://www.nationalmasscarestrategy.org/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/Shelter-Field-Guide-508_f3.pdf

shelter_usable_fraction.source: Planning assumption: sleeping area share of gross floor area (aisles, kitchens, toilets, stairs excluded); Riverside County OA Mass Care guidance example: 10,000 sf gym -> 250 people (40 sf each, ~100% of a clear gym floor), multi-storey buildings have less clear floor

projected_shelter_nights.source: Georgia State Shelter Plan 2024 (GEMA): evacuation shelters typically open < 72 hours; used to price person-nights beyond the 6 h sim window

shelter_staff_per_100.source: Planning assumption after American Red Cross shelter staffing practice (FEMA P-785 Shelter Field Guide staffing chapter); used for shelter staff person-hours

meals_per_person_day.source: FEMA / Ready.gov food planning: three meals per person per day; FEMA commodity planning factors

water_gal_per_person_day.source: FEMA Ready.gov 'Water': at least one gallon of water per person per day, https://www.ready.gov/water

truck_payload_kg.source: Class 6 box/flatbed truck (19,501-26,000 lb GVW) payload ~10,000 lb, US DOE AFDC vehicle weight classes, https://afdc.energy.gov/data/10380

meal_kg.source: MRE ~0.6-0.75 kg each (DLA Troop Support MRE fact sheet)

water_kg_per_gal.source: physical constant (1 US gal = 3.785 L of water)

truck_load_unload_s.source: Planning assumption (20 min dock time per shelter stop)

bus_capacity.source: FEMA 2023 rate 8180 Bus (standard transit bus seated capacity ~40)

rescue_boat_persons_per_trip.source: FEMA NIMS Resource Typing (RTLT) Swiftwater/Flood Rescue Boat Team: typical 4-6 survivors per trip for small flood boats

rescue_boat_speed_ms.source: Planning assumption: shallow urban flood water, obstacles (walking-pace to slow motoring)

rescue_load_s.source: Planning assumption: 10 min to locate, load and secure survivors

rescue_crew_size.source: FEMA RTLT Swiftwater/Flood Search and Rescue Team: boat squads of ~4

sffd_baseline_rescue_units.source: Assumption: SFFD Rescue Squads 1 and 2 (water-rescue capable) available to this district when no plan stages more crews

sffd_dispatch_delay_s.source: Assumption: 30 min from first at-risk call to boat on scene during a city-wide storm (unstaged)

tree_crew_clear_s.source: Planning assumption: 30 min to cut and clear one fallen street tree from a lane (SF Public Works Bureau of Urban Forestry crews)

sandbag_bags_per_m_03m.source: USACE pyramid sandbag dike (6 bags/ft at 1 ft), via data/reference/unit_costs_research.json 'sandbag_bags_per_ft_usace'

sandbag_bags_per_crew_hour.source: Sandbag Cost Analysis (2023) in unit_costs_research.json: 11,700 sandbags / 455 man-hours

building_doorway_m.unit: m of sandbag line per protected building
building_doorway_m.source: Planning assumption: entrances + garage/basement openings of a typical SF row building frontage (~7.6 m lot)

medical_post_staff.source: Planning assumption: field treatment site (2 EMT teams + lead), FEMA RTLT medical strike team

rescue_boat_shuttle_m.unit: m one-way boat shuttle per trip
rescue_boat_shuttle_m.source: Planning assumption: boats are trailered by road to the water's edge (drive_speed) and shuttle ~150 m through flooded streets per trip (urban flood blocks ~100-200 m)
